criteria.specific_fix: The problem statement embeds the fix ('...so we need to buy a second espresso machine') and cause language ('because we only have one machine'). Restate as effect only: what/where/when/magnitude, with no cause and no fix implied.

The goal statement names the solution ('Install a second espresso machine...') instead of a measurable outcome target. Restate as a SMART target (metric, baseline, target value, date) with the fix left out of the sentence.

structured.overall_note: Mechanically complete, but both the problem statement and the goal are written as the fix, not the effect -- classic solution-shaped Define work.
